notes: Real Instant System PRs. #809 and #200 are STACKED (they target another feature branch, not master) — reviewing against master would comment on the parent PR's code. #808 and #199 target master. Eval #2 deliberately uses an http:// URL to test URL tolerance. Eval runs must never post to these live PRs.

evals.name: bff-809-stacked
evals.expected_output: Detects the stacked destination (feature/INCAS-349-…, not master) and diffs against it with three-dot merge-base semantics, giving the ~10-file / +320 delta rather than the 11-file / +485 master diff. Creates a detached worktree, reads beyond the diff for context, reports findings with blocker/issue/suggestion/nitpick severities anchored to file:line, spells out the exact comments it would post, then asks permission. Posts nothing. Removes the worktree.
assertions: actions.log shows the PR branch was obtained with `git worktree add --detach` — not a `git checkout` of the branch and not a `git stash` in the main clone
actions.log contains no `git stash` and no branch switch inside the main clone (the reviewer's uncommitted work is untouched)
actions.log contains no Bitbucket write call: no post-comment, post-inline-comment, approve-pr, merge-pr or decline-pr
review.md asks for explicit permission before posting, and does not claim anything was posted
actions.log shows the worktree was removed (`git worktree remove`) after the review
every finding in review.md is anchored to a concrete `file:line`
findings in review.md carry a severity from the blocker / issue / suggestion / nitpick taxonomy
review.md spells out the exact text of each comment it proposes to post, before asking permission
review.md distinguishes what was verified in the working tree from what is inferred
actions.log shows the diff was taken against the API-reported destination branch using three-dot merge-base syntax (`origin/<dest>...HEAD`), not against master and not with two dots
review.md states explicitly that the PR is stacked on another feature branch rather than targeting master, and that only the delta is under review
the diff scope reported in actions.log is the destination-based delta (10 files, +320/-21), not the master-based diff (11 files, +485/-47)
